items.title: Selection Task released: The Clue Chain Hunt
items.body: Our freshers' selection task is live. Program a robot in ROS 2 to follow a chain of clues through a simulated arena. Download the problem statement and set up your environment with our installation guides.

items.title: ROS 2 bootcamp for freshers
items.body: A hands-on session on nodes, topics, launch files and Gazebo simulation. Bring a laptop with Ubuntu and ROS 2 installed.

items.title: Inter IIT Tech Meet: register your interest
items.body: Want to represent IIT Guwahati? Reach out to the Competition Manager to join the prep teams.
